items.heading: Different Rooms Ask the Same
items.text: Different rooms ask the same question for different reasons. Know which room you are in.

items.heading: These Are Shapes to Adapt,
items.text: These are shapes to adapt, not scripts to memorise. Replace the details with your own.

items.heading: A Title Says You Passed
items.text: A title says you passed exams. Proof says you can do the work. Bring one or two of these, not all.

figures.label: Education Budget
figures.source: Count the full cost of the route, including coaching, books, registration and exam fees. Keep the college or class share near 10 percent of your total education budget and treat more than 20 percent as a caution.
